Landing.headline: The council is in session.
Landing.subhead: Convene a panel of AI personas to deliberate a question through a structured protocol and produce a synthesized deliverable.
Landing.phaseOpeningBody: All personas answer the question in parallel, blind to each other. Diversity preserved.
Landing.phaseCritiqueBody: Round-robin critique with a novelty requirement: refine, challenge, or concede.
Landing.phaseConsensusBody: A judge model scores the debate and decides whether another round is worth running.
Landing.phaseAdaptiveBody: If consensus stalls, the weakest voice is silenced and the strongest speaks last.
Landing.phaseSynthesisBody: A secretary model produces the deliverable: decision, key arguments, minority views, next actions.
Landing.featureByokBody: OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google — or local via Ollama or LM Studio. Your keys, your models, your bill.
Landing.featureDurableBody: Workflows run on Inngest, not on the HTTP request. Close the tab — the debate keeps going.
Landing.featureStreamBody: Watch every turn as it streams. Reconnect at any time and replay from any point.
Landing.featurePauseBody: Drop a note between phases. The council sees it before the next round begins.

Errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this resource.
Errors.invalid_key: Your OpenRouter key was rejected. Reconnect OpenRouter in Settings.
Errors.insufficient_credits: Your OpenRouter account is out of credits for this model. Add credits on openrouter.ai or pick a free model.
Errors.rate_limited: This model is rate-limited right now. Free models allow a limited number of requests per day; try again later or pick another model.
Errors.model_unavailable: This model is not available on OpenRouter right now. Pick a different one.
Errors.context_too_long: The conversation got too long for this model. Pick a model with a larger context window.
Errors.timeout: The model took too long to answer.
Errors.empty_response: The model returned an empty answer.
Errors.not_enough_participants: Fewer than two panelists could answer, so there was nothing to debate. Try again with other models.
Errors.unknown: The debate stopped because of an unexpected error. Your transcript so far is saved.
Errors.synthesis_failed: None of the panel's models could write the final summary. The transcript is saved; try again with a stronger model.

NewSession.heading: What should the council help you with?
NewSession.questionPlaceholder: What is the best go-to-market strategy for our launch this quarter, given current team capacity?
NewSession.freeOnlyHint: Free models cost nothing but are limited to a set number of requests per day by OpenRouter.
NewSession.advancedHint: The judge scores consensus between rounds; the secretary writes the final summary. Auto picks them from the live catalog.
NewSession.needs: Need a title, a question (10+ characters), 2–5 panelists, and a model for each.
NewSession.catalogError: Couldn't load the model list from OpenRouter. Reload to try again.
NewSession.retryBanner: Starting over from a previous session. Adjust the models and try again.
NewSession.connectBody: Parloir runs debates on your own OpenRouter account. You pay OpenRouter directly for what you use, and free models cost nothing.
NewSession.connectBodySelfHost: Parloir runs debates on models you bring yourself: an API key (OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) or a local server (Ollama, LM Studio).
NewSession.localNoteBody: The judge and the final summary need a model that reliably returns structured JSON. Small local models often can't. Use a capable local model, or connect OpenRouter as a fallback.

Settings.title: Settings

Settings.connectedOk: OpenRouter is connected. You're ready to start a debate.
Settings.connectError: Connecting to OpenRouter didn't work. Try again, or paste a key instead.
Settings.orHint: One account, hundreds of models, including free ones. Parloir uses your account; you pay OpenRouter directly for what you use.
Settings.orManage: Manage this key and its spending limit on openrouter.ai
Settings.orFreeTier: Free tier: free models are limited to about 50 requests a day (roughly 2–3 debates). Buying $10 of OpenRouter credits raises that to 1,000.
Settings.orInvalid: OpenRouter rejected this key. Reconnect to keep using Parloir.
Settings.otherHint: Self-hosted only: direct API keys and local model servers.
Settings.anthropicHint: Direct API key for Claude models.
Settings.openaiHint: Direct API key for OpenAI models.
Settings.privacy: Keys are encrypted at rest and only used to run your debates. Disconnecting deletes the key from Parloir.

Council.pausedPrompt: Deliberation paused. Add a note to steer the next phase, or resume without interjecting.
Council.interjectPlaceholder: Interject: your note is added to the transcript before the next speaker.

Council.suggestion2: Ask the panel to name one assumption they haven't checked
